name: codex-memory-pro
description: Codex semantic memory plugin adapted from Claude Memory Pro. Provides LanceDB-backed hybrid recall, memory storage, cleanup, habit signals, and knowledge-graph routed retrieval through MCP.

interface.longDescription: Codex Memory Pro brings the Claude Memory Pro retrieval stack to Codex through MCP: LanceDB vector storage, BM25 hybrid retrieval, knowledge-graph routing, time and importance weighting, memory cleanup, habit signals, and explicit recall/store/update tools.
